hints.title: Include All Users
hints.text: Users who have taken zero rides must appear in the final table with a travelled distance of 0.

hints.title: Null Coalescing Sum
hints.text: left join Rides on Users.id = Rides.user_id and apply ifnull(sum(distance), 0).

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Sort Order
hints.text: order by travelled_distance desc, name asc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT u.name,
       IFNULL(SUM(r.distance), 0) AS travelled_distance
FROM Users u
LEFT JOIN Rides r ON u.id = r.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
ORDER BY travelled_distance DESC, u.name ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Left join followed by grouping by user id runs in linear time, followed by sorting users.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner join omits users without any rides instead of reporting 0 distance.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping by unique user key guarantees accurate aggregation even with duplicate names.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Left outer join with COALESCE or IFNULL handling zero rides and secondary name sorting.

solutions.code:
